paragraphs.text:
CIVIL ORIGINAL/CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION

 TRANSFER PETITION (CIVIL) NO.1689 OF 2017

 SWATI CHAUDHARY Petitioner

 VERSUS

 NITESH KUMAR Respondent

 WITH

 SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRL.) NO.8158/2018

 SWATI CHAUDARY Petitioner

 VERSUS

 NITESH KUMAR & ANOTHER Respondents

 O R D E R
Learned counsel for the parties submit that the parties have

 resolved their inter se disputes and the proceedings have been

 withdrawn pursuant to the said settlement.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that she has

 instructions to withdraw the Transfer Petition as well as the

 Special Leave Petition.
Statement recorded.
The Transfer Petition as well as the Special Leave Petition

 are, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn.

OCTOBER 04, 2021
